bibliographic.title: Mindware
bibliographic.author: Jerce
bibliographic.description:
Mindware is a psychological horror Twine experience about memory, identity, and the technology that reshapes both.
You awaken inside a strange mental interface — a place where your thoughts glitch, choices spiral, and the line between what’s yours and what’s programmed begins to collapse.

Designed as interactive fiction with an unsettling, surreal atmosphere, Mindware blends inner monologue, distorted visuals, and branching choices to trap players inside a mind that may not belong to them.

Short. Intense. Disorienting.
